chunks.text:
Product Profile
Sahbhagi Dhan is an early-maturing, semi-dwarf variety characterized by long-bold grains, widely adaptable variety, mainly grown as direct seeded rice in rainfed and upland environments. Developed collaboratively by CRRI, Hajaribag, and IRRI, it was released in 2009 for cultivation in Jharkhand and Odisha. Notably, it exhibits tolerance to drought and displays exceptional adaptability to water-scarce and upland environments.

Key Strengths
- Drought tolerant
- Semi-dwarf; Profuse tillering; High straw yield
- Long bold grain
- Early maturity; Non-lodging
- High HRR; Excellent eating quality
- Tolerant to Leaf blast, Sheath blight & Leaf folder
